## Summary

Explain the user-visible or architectural change in a few sentences.

## Evidence

Describe the tests, benchmarks, or manual checks you ran. For retrieval or procedural changes, include the command and before/after results where applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this PR focused on one coherent change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- [ ] I called out any change that affects a hard rule or safety gate.
